evidence_boundary: Calculated and structural statements about a supplied model. They do not establish that the model describes a physical system, and they do not establish novelty; both need comparison with experiment and with the literature.
question: Which changes turn the epidemic model with higher-order infection into a symmetric switch?
assumptions: SIS epidemic dynamics with recovery and no explicit susceptible replenishment term
Symmetric coupling between the two populations
Pairwise interactions both within and between populations

provenance.source: I. Z. Kiss, C. Bick and P. L. Simon, Decoding how higher-order network interactions shape complex contagion dynamics, J. Math. Biol. 91, 29 (2025), doi:10.1007/s00285-025-02247-4, arXiv:2410.15330
provenance.kind: equations of the source paper, as extracted from its LaTeX
